instruction: This is the launch reel and it is not finished. Please do the whole job on it: find the most engaging moment we could open on, take out the pauses and the places she says the same thing twice, swap the one camera angle that is doing nothing for the other angle we shot of the same moment, put in the cutaway that actually matches what she is saying, fix the caption that gets the number wrong, move the name bar so it stops fighting the captions, and get the levels so her voice sits on top of the music. Leave the grade, the transitions, the framing, the linked audio and everything the human already changed exactly as it is. Then export it, and check the export rather than the timeline.

interpretation.restated_outcome: One launch reel, one pass, seven editorial changes and a verified export: open on the strongest moment, take the pauses and the repeated statements out, replace the camera angle that is doing nothing with the other angle of the same moment, insert the cutaway that matches the words, correct the caption that misstates a number, move the name bar off the captions, and balance the levels - leaving the grade, the transitions, the framing, the linked audio and every human edit exactly as they are - then export and check the FILE.
